versions.changelog:
yoooclaw-world-cup-match-talk-scene-en v1.0.0

- Initial release: Generate World Cup football conversation kits from standardized match input.
- Supports multiple output modules: 30-second summary, main highlights, trending discussions, expert-sounding lines, and Moments copywriting.
- Allows users to select focus areas (teams/players, discussion depth, groups/applications for notifications).
- Integrates Chinese public sports sources and mobile notifications for richer context.
- Provides structured workflows for match confirmation, information collection, and relevance filtering.
- For World Cup football matches only; does not generalize to other sports by default.
